page.overview:
Who is Queen Haven?

Queen Haven is a female Pegasus pony and supporting character in the My Little Pony Generation 5 film My Little Pony: A New Generation and subsequent Generation 5 media. She is the queen of the metropolitan Pegasus city of Zephyr Heights and the mother of Pipp Petals and Zipp Storm.__TOC__

Queen Haven's name is similar to the G4 seapony Haven Bay.

In the film My Little Pony: A New Generation, Queen Haven appears as the queen of the Pegasus city of Zephyr Heights, along with her princess daughters Pipp Petals and Zipp Storm. She first appears "flying" down into the throne room after Sunny Starscout and Izzy Moonbow are captured and brought before; she is shocked to see an Earth pony and unicorn in Zephyr Heights and orders their immediate imprisonment in the palace dungeon. Zipp later releases them, and after learning Pegasi are unable to fly due to the lack of magic in Equestria, they work together to steal the Pegasus Unity Crystal from Queen Haven's crown.

When the three steal the crystal during Pipp's concert and the public learns that the royal family lied about being able to fly, Queen Haven is arrested while her daughters escape with Sunny, Izzy, and Hitch Trailblazer to obtain the other Unity Crystals. Haven later breaks out of prison to find her daughters, reuniting with them in the unicorn village of Bridlewood and resulting in a three-way confrontation with Alphabittle and the unicorns. When Sunny and Izzy join the Pegasus and Unicorn Crystals together, expecting magic to return, nothing happens, and a disappointed Sunny returns the Pegasus Crystal to Haven.
